summary: Sheriff's deputies booked a man on a charge of violating a domestic-violence protection order and another on a charge of possessing a controlled substance with intent to distribute on Wednesday. The jail roster showed 23 criminal bookings dated Nov. 4 and none yet on Nov. 5.

entries.title: Protection-order arrest: Darris O'Neil Grace
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Darris O'Neil Grace, 30, at 8:20 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday morning.
He was booked on a charge of violating a domestic-violence protection order — disobeying a court order to stay away from or not contact a protected person.

entries.title: Drug arrests: Charlie Oniel Crook, Micah Peyton Clark
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Charlie Oniel Crook, 38, on Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of possession of a controlled substance with intent to distribute, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

Fairhope police arrested Micah Peyton Clark, 28, at 11:57 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, at Section Street and Gayfer Avenue; the city's arrest log lists unlawful possession of a controlled substance (THC oil). He was booked into the county jail Wednesday on a charge of possession of dangerous drugs and was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Drunk-driving arrest: Savannah Aaliyah Fretwell
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Savannah Aaliyah Fretwell, 23, at 6:15 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol, according to the jail roster. She was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

entries.title: Sex offender registration arrest: Marcus Ezekiel McKillion
body: Marcus Ezekiel McKillion, 28, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 1:02 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on a charge listed as SORNA — a violation of Alabama's sex offender registration and notification law. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

entries.title: Indecent exposure arrest: Raymond Alexander Madison
body: Raymond Alexander Madison, 33, was booked into the county jail by sheriff's deputies on Wednesday, Nov. 4, according to the jail roster. The roster gives an arrest date of Aug. 21 at 3:24 a.m.
He was booked on charges of disorderly conduct (disturbing the peace) and indecent exposure — exposing oneself in a way likely to offend. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

entries.title: Bay Minette arrests: Laquila Nashay Andrews, Shauna Michelle Whitley
body: Bay Minette police arrested Laquila Nashay Andrews, 35, at 3:09 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of theft of lost property — keeping property known to be lost without trying to return it, according to the jail roster. She was released the same day.
Police arrested Shauna Michelle Whitley, 40, at 11:37 a.m. Wednesday on two counts of failure to appear, comply or pay. The roster shows her released.

entries.title: Fugitive arrest: John Alexander Michael Burns
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested John Alexander Michael Burns, 37, at 12:30 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, on a charge of being a fugitive from justice — held on a warrant from another state, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday.

entries.title: Assault on officer arrest: Cordairo Samuel Oneal McCall
body: Cordairo Samuel Oneal McCall, 39, was arrested by sheriff's deputies on Tuesday, Nov. 3, according to the jail roster. The roster gives no time of arrest.

He was booked on a charge of aggravated assault on a police officer, listed as strong-arm — an assault on an officer with hands, fists or feet rather than a weapon. He was in custody when the roster was read Wednesday.

entries.title: Family assault arrest: Christopher Michael Kelly
body: Christopher Michael Kelly, 55, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 10:54 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on a charge of aggravated assault on a family or household member, listed as strong-arm — a serious assault without a weapon. He was in custody when the roster was read Wednesday.

entries.title: Shooting at 18-wheeler arrest: Jason Cameron Chandler
body: Jason Cameron Chandler, 23, of Bay Minette was arrested by Baldwin County sheriff's deputies at 7:31 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, according to the jail roster.

The sheriff's office said in a Nov. 3 release that a driver reported his 18-wheeler was struck by a bullet on Highway 59 near Bay Minette on Thursday, Oct. 29. Deputies recovered a large-caliber projectile from the cab and saw damage consistent with a gunshot, the release says. Investigators reviewed the truck's video, identified a dark Chevrolet Avalanche with distinctive white decals, and later found a matching vehicle at a Bay Minette home. The sheriff's office says Chandler admitted owning the vehicle and firing a handgun at the passing truck, called it a random act and offered no motive. No injuries were reported, and the sheriff's office says it believes the incident was isolated.

He was booked on a charge of shooting into an occupied building or vehicle — firing a gun into an occupied structure or vehicle. The sheriff's office describes the charge as discharging a firearm into an occupied vehicle. The roster shows him released Tuesday, Nov. 3.

entries.title: Family harassment arrests: Timothy Alton Hart, Christopher Warren McKeel
body: Bay Minette police arrested Timothy Alton Hart, 22, at 1:50 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, on a charge of harassment of a family or household member, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Wednesday.

Sheriff's deputies arrested Christopher Warren McKeel, 43, at 10:56 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, and he was booked Tuesday on charges of harassment of a family or household member and possession of dangerous drugs. The roster shows him released Tuesday.

entries.title: Bay Minette arrests: Anthony Oneal Lambert, Contarius Monta Robinson
body: Bay Minette police arrested Anthony Oneal Lambert, 58, at 11:45 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, on a charge of coercion, listed as harassment or intimidation, according to the jail roster. He was booked early Wednesday and was in custody when the roster was read.
Police arrested Contarius Monta Robinson, 29, at 12:20 p.m. Tuesday on a charge of tampering with physical evidence — destroying, hiding or altering evidence. He was released the same day.

entries.title: Theft and stolen-property arrests: four booked Nov. 3
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Alijia Carlise Jones, 27, on Tuesday, Nov. 3, on two counts of organized retail theft — stealing merchandise from stores to resell or in concert with others — according to the jail roster. She was released the same day.

Deputies arrested Jennifer Lindsey Lewis, 43, at 5:06 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2, and Ernesto Cedillo, 39, at 8:26 p.m. Monday, each on a charge of buying or receiving stolen property, and Amanda Kristen Connell, 41, at 8:30 p.m. Monday on a theft charge. All three were booked Tuesday and released the same day. The roster does not say whether any of these arrests are connected.

entries.title: Drug arrests: Wesley Michael Norris, Kristian Vidal Carrillo
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Wesley Michael Norris, 41, on Tuesday, Nov. 3, on a charge of possession of dangerous drugs, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read Wednesday.

Deputies arrested Kristian Vidal Carrillo, 26, at 11:37 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2, on charges of possession of dangerous drugs, first-offense drug paraphernalia and illegal possession of prescription drugs. He was booked Tuesday and released the same day.

entries.title: Sex offender registration arrest: Brian Thomas Pendleton
body: Brian Thomas Pendleton, 46, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 12:52 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on two counts of failure of an adult sex offender to register with local law enforcement or comply with residence restrictions. The roster shows him released the same day.

entries.title: Drunk-driving arrests: three booked Nov. 2–3
body: State troopers arrested Tina Marie Whittington St Clair, 53, at 5:10 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2, on a charge of driving under the influence of a controlled substance, according to the jail roster. The roster shows her released Tuesday, Nov. 3.

Sheriff's deputies arrested Janessa Leigh Peden, 29, at 10:26 a.m. Monday on charges of driving under the influence of alcohol and failure to signal; she was released the same day. Deputies arrested Anthony Jermaine Hale, 49, at 11:05 p.m. Monday on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol; he was booked early Tuesday and was in custody when the roster was read.
